name: Thermal Protection Systems & Ablative Materials
summary: Explains the materials that protect spacecraft and missiles from re-entry and propulsion heating, from reusable tiles to charring ablators.

topics.name: Aerothermal environments of re-entry and hypersonic flight; heat-flux and heat-load
Heat-management strategies: heat sink, radiative, insulative, ablative and transpiration cooling
Reusable TPS: silica tiles (LI-900), AETB/TUFI, flexible insulation blankets
Ablative materials: carbon-phenolic, PICA, AVCOAT, SLA-561V and cork-based ablators
Ablation physics: pyrolysis, char formation, surface recession and blowing
Ultra-high-temperature ceramics for sharp leading edges
Rocket nozzle and throat materials: graphite, C/C, C/SiC and refractory metals
Insulation materials: aerogels and multilayer insulation
Arc-jet testing and qualification of TPS
TPS design for Mars entry, lunar return and reusable launch vehicles
Case studies: Space Shuttle, Apollo, Stardust, Orion and Starship heat shields
